messages:
marie: Quick sync on cramped metric rows — when cards are <=240px the y-axis and unit pills push sparklines down and rows jitter. Brainstorm: compact "chips" for `p50/p95` + unit, a left compressed axis toggle, or single-line ellipsize with accessible tooltip. Also: anomaly markers vs dimming, and whether smoothing is a per-card toggle or global. Thoughts?

sam: Chips sound nice. Use `p95 · ms` tokenized so each legend item stays short. Tap the chip to open a small popover with full metric name + last value. Avoid hover-only controls.

alex: For smoothing default to median-of-3 client-side (cheap, preserves spikes). Expose per-card toggle but keep a global default setting. Microcopy: label `Smoothing (reduce noise)` with tooltip `Median smoothing preserves sharp spikes; disable to inspect raw values.`

toni: Accessibility: if you show chips, include a hidden SR string with the full phrase: "95th percentile latency (p95) in milliseconds". Make chips focusable and use aria-expanded when the popover is open. Popover must trap focus and be reachable via keyboard.

marie: Outliers: dimming feels like hiding. Proposal: show a hollow diamond marker for anomalies and a small cluster badge `+N` when many overlap. Legend entry: "◊ anomaly — deviates from baseline". Toggle called `Highlight anomalies`.

sam: When `Highlight anomalies` is off, keep lines undimmed. When on, show markers and expose a condensed anomaly list under chart. Provide export link `Export anomalies (CSV)`.

toni: Marker aria example: aria-label="Anomaly: 2025-09-12 14:00 — 820 req/s (~4x baseline)". For clusters, aria-label="Cluster: 3 anomalies between 14:00014:10; press Enter to expand list". Also provide a `View anomalies (table)` link for SR users.

alex: Impl note: client median-of-3 is fine. Cluster detection can be a spatial pass on plotted x positions. Keep smoothing deterministic so cached renders stable.

marie: Actions: (1) I'll mock chip + cluster badge + popover states; (2) sam opens eng ticket for per-card smoothing toggle + anomaly export; (3) toni will draft exact SR strings and example announcements. Will post mocks and SR copy in ~90m. :thumbsup:
